_comment: enabled:false = kill switch (compose, publish nothing). mode:draft = Buffer drafts for review / live = schedule for real. research_per_day = target AI-trend posts per day, EACH cross-posted to every channel in `channels` (raise this digit to scale up; the quality gate still applies). linkedin_format = the LinkedIn format policy (full rules in config/carousel.md). 'text-first' (CURRENT, 2026-06-16 pivot) = LinkedIn posts default to hook-driven TEXT; a carousel deck ships only on the rare day a topic clears the deck-worthy gate (a genuine framework / data breakdown / step-by-step on a hiring or AI-x-hiring topic) AND no carousel has already shipped this ISO week (~1x/week MAX, most days no deck). 'carousel' (LEGACY/DORMANT) = every LinkedIn post ships as a carousel PDF deck, one per research topic. 'auto' = the old conditional (carousel only for framework/breakdown posts, no weekly cap). X has no native carousel (single image only) and is suspended anyway. skip_days = weekday abbrevs (UTC) to NOT post on (mon,tue,wed,thu,fri,sat,sun). posting_windows_utc = ordered list of 'HH:MM-HH:MM' UTC windows the routine schedules dueAt into (Step 8); currently ['15:30-17:30','22:00-00:00'] (2026-06-16 pivot) tuned for the HR/exec audience: window 1 = 11:30am-1:30pm US Eastern (prime US LinkedIn for senior HR/TA + founders) and kept clear of the Ployo diary's ~12:45-15:00 UTC slot; window 2 = ~8-10am AEST (AU mid-morning, secondary). With research_per_day=1 the day's single post lands in window 1 via the 00:30 UTC run. The 00:30 UTC run fills the FIRST window, the 12:30 UTC run the SECOND; LinkedIn-only now (X dormant), each post a random independent minute inside. Edit these to retime posts — no routine-prompt change needed. The Ployo diary routine separately posts 1 diary/day to these same channels. product_spotlight = a SECOND content stream (separate from research_per_day): a builder's-lens take on a notable NEW PRODUCT launch (Product Hunt / Show HN). enabled = on/off; run = which daily run produces it ('second' = the 12:30 UTC run only); linkedin_max_per_week = hard cap on product-spotlight LinkedIn carousels per ISO week (X is daily, uncapped). Full rules + the builder's-lens framing (never a thumbs-up/down verdict, never dunk on the makers) live in config/product-spotlight.md. takes = a THIRD stream (X-only, TEXT-only): one of Ahmed's pre-approved strongest opinions from state/opinion-bank.json, developed into a standalone long-form X post (no image/link/thread, never LinkedIn). enabled = on/off; per_day = max takes/UTC-day (start 1; bump to 2 AND set run:'any' to scale); run = which run fires it ('first' = 00:30 UTC run -> morning window, 'second' = 12:30, 'any' = both -- with per_day:1 'any' means the FIRST run of the day that hasn't hit the cap, i.e. normally the morning run, and the daily guard prevents doubles; 'any' also lets manual test runs produce one). Full rules in config/takes.md; the bank is hand-edited by Ahmed, the routine only updates last_used/times_used.
